faqs.question: How is responsive web design different from mobile-friendly web design?
faqs.answer: A mobile-friendly site displays on mobile but may require pinch-to-zoom. A responsive website dynamically rearranges its layout, images, and content to fit the exact screen dimensions of the viewing device.

faqs.question: What is the difference between adaptive design and responsive design?
faqs.answer: Responsive design uses fluid grids and CSS media queries to adapt continuously to any screen size. Adaptive design uses static layouts for predefined screen breakpoints.

faqs.question: Can responsive design improve my website’s search engine rankings?
faqs.answer: Yes! Google uses mobile-first indexing, meaning it ranks sites based on their mobile version. Fast, responsive websites rank significantly higher in search results.

faqs.question: How long does it take to make our existing website responsive?
faqs.answer: Depending on the size and complexity of your existing site, converting it to a fully responsive design typically takes between 1 and 3 weeks.

faqs.question: Will a responsive design slow down my website on mobile devices?
faqs.answer: Not with TechBeeps! We use responsive images (srcset), CSS modern layout techniques, and asset minification to ensure blazing-fast load times on mobile networks.
